Subject: Draft: Stepwise Adoption & Evaluation Timeline (MAP) for StellarBev

Hi Elena,

Thanks again for a productive call this morning. As discussed, I pulled together a lightweight Mutual Action Plan (MAP) focused on a stepwise evaluation and close timeline so we can align expectations across Product, Procurement, and Engineering.

I've attached a Google Doc template and a short slide outline. Please click in and edit directly — I set the doc to allow comments so we can mark acceptance criteria and required sign-offs.

Proposed high-level timeline (can adjust based on procurement windows):
- Week 0 (Aug 10–14): Finalize MAP, confirm stakeholders and SLAs
- Week 1 (Aug 17–21): Data/workload sample handoff + evaluation criteria sign-off
- Week 2 (Aug 24–28): Provision eval environment + smoke tests
- Week 3 (Aug 31–Sep 4): Focused pilot & quality gate review
- Week 4 (Sep 7–11): Final acceptance, contracting and procurement kickoff

Could you confirm the tentative timeline and add any internal procurement dates? If it helps, we're available for a 30-min alignment on Tue Aug 11 or Wed Aug 12.

Attachments (stubs):
- RDW_MAP_Template_StellarBev.gdoc (editable MAP template)
- RDW_MAP_Slides_StellarBev.gslides (1-slide timeline + owners)
- procurement-checklist.pdf (procurement pre-reqs)

Next steps I suggest: you edit the doc with dates/owners, we lock the eval environment window, and I'll loop in our SRE to provision test capacity.

Thanks,
Dylan Brooks
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
D: +1 415-555-0192
